dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline from the apex to the mid-section, terminating in a prominent V-shaped notch at the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Tight pixel radius with a rounded shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour measuring approximately 68 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 4.2:1 ratio of the visible longitudinal base length to the maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant primary notch at the basal trailing edge of the fin, accompanied by multiple irregular serrations and small indentations along the trailing dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive elongated and low-profile anterior dorsal ridge that extends significantly forward from the primary fin base.
